verifications.claim: Crypto ATMs (or BTMs) are physical kiosks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Cryptocurrency kiosks, also called crypto ATMs" (R2); "Usually set up as a small kiosk with a screen interface" (R4); "Bitcoin ATMS are self-service kiosks" (R5); "A Bitcoin ATM is a kiosk" (R7); "Bitcoin ATMs, or “BTMs,”" (R9); "A Bitcoin ATM (or BTM) is a physical kiosk" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly define crypto ATMs/BTMs as physical kiosks or machines.

verifications.claim: Crypto ATMs are often located in convenience stores and supermarkets.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "located in supermarkets, bars, convenience stores" (R2); "convenience stores and gas stations" (R6); "convenience stores, gas stations and shopping centers" (R7); "gas stations, convenience stores, and malls" (R8); "convenience stores, gas stations, cafes, and supermarkets" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly list convenience stores and supermarkets as common locations.

verifications.claim: Crypto ATMs allow users to buy cryptocurrency using cash or debit cards.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "buy Bitcoin with cash" (R1); "Buy Crypto with Cash" (R3); "using cash or a debit card" (R5); "using cash or a debit card" (R7); "buy Bitcoin with your cash" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm buying with cash, and some specify debit cards as well.

verifications.claim: Crypto ATMs sometimes allow users to sell cryptocurrency using cash or debit cards.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Sell Crypto for Cash" (R3); "support selling Bitcoin in exchange for cash" (R5); "buy or sell cryptocurrency using cash or a debit card" (R7); "sell cryptocurrency and withdraw cash" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm bidirectional ATMs allow selling for cash; R7 uses parallel phrasing to claim.

verifications.claim: Crypto ATMs provide instant transactions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Get crypto in minutes" (R1); "instant settlement... credited to your wallet immediately" (R5); "Your Bitcoin will be sent to your wallet immediately" (R10); "Get your Bitcoin in minutes!" (R11)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe transactions as immediate or in minutes.

verifications.claim: Crypto ATM transactions have fees of 6%-20%+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Buying Bitcoin 6% – 20%" (R7); "median fee for buying Bitcoin... is 16 percent... When selling Bitcoin, the median fee... is 15 percent" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: R7 matches range exactly; R9 supports high fees around that range.

verifications.claim: Crypto ATMs require a digital wallet app.

verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state a digital wallet is required.

verifications.claim: Crypto ATMs require a phone number.
verifications.label: VAGUE

verifications.reasoning: Some sources describe phone requirement, but not universally ('some machines').
